summary: Iter 27 frontend-only test: JOY Ecosystem micro-strip replacement verified on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). All 7 acceptance criteria pass. Previous 5-card grid is gone and replaced with a compact, monospace, overline-style strip.

acceptance_criteria_results.hero_ecosystem_above_h1: PASS — In DOM source order eco (line 317) precedes H1 (line 349). Visually confirmed on mobile screenshot: overline → 5 pillars → 'Smarter parts. Stronger journeys. One platform.' H1 appears directly below.
acceptance_criteria_results.height_under_100px_desktop: PASS — clientHeight = 68px at 1440 viewport (well under 100px threshold).
acceptance_criteria_results.all_5_pillars_testids_and_copy: PASS — hero-eco-pillar-01..05 all present. Content verified via textContent (case-insensitive): 01='B2B Platform — Workshops & car dealers', 02='B2C — E-commerce automobiles for retail', 03='Experience Centre — Flagship store', 04='AI-Driven Data Co. — Industry intelligence layer', 05='JOY BEAST Atelier — Body kits · forged rims · bespoke & tuning'.
acceptance_criteria_results.joy_ecosystem_overline_and_gradient: PASS — 'THE JOY ECOSYSTEM' overline present with flex-1 h-px bg-gradient-to-r hairline divider next to it.
acceptance_criteria_results.mobile_wraps_no_overflow: PASS — 390px viewport, scrollWidth=390 == clientWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow). Strip wraps across ~5 lines with '/' dividers.
acceptance_criteria_results.regression_h1_ctas_bodykits_genius_chips: PASS — H1 contains 'Smarter parts', hero-google-login-button and hero-retail-link visible, #joy-beast section renders, Mr Genius FAB button present (label 'ASK MR GENIUS', testid='guardian-bot-trigger') and clickable, mobile-scroll-spy with 6 chips (home/joy-beast/experience-centre/tech-stack/catalogue/bd-news) visible, header-search-trigger present.

critical_code_review_comments: Mr Genius trigger testid is named 'guardian-bot-trigger' while the visible label is 'ASK MR GENIUS' — naming mismatch is legacy; consider renaming to 'genius-bot-trigger' for clarity (not blocking).

Landing.jsx is 793 lines — exceeds the 700-line threshold. Consider extracting BangladeshNewsSection, ThemeToggle, StatCounter, ExpTile, and Stat into /src/components/landing/* to improve maintainability.

Ecosystem pillar text uses CSS uppercase, so innerText returns uppercase even though source is mixed-case. Tests that compare via innerText must do case-insensitive comparison — preserved for future agents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 27 JOY Ecosystem micro-strip redesign is complete and passing. Testids: hero-ecosystem (container), hero-eco-pillar-01..05 (individual pillars). Pillars 01 & 05 are red-featured, 02/03/04 zinc. Mr Genius FAB uses data-testid='guardian-bot-trigger' (legacy name, label reads 'ASK MR GENIUS'). Mobile chip nav wrapper testid='mobile-scroll-spy' with chip-<section-id> for each chip. When asserting pillar text, use case-insensitive textContent matching because CSS applies uppercase transform.
